name: Basic Layouts
project_description: Basic Layouts ships five ready-to-use layout plugins for Layout Builder (and any layout-aware context): One column, One column (grid), Two column, Three column, and Four column. Each layout is backed by a single plugin class that optionally renders an editor-supplied formatted intro text above the section's regions. A settings form can unset core's default onecol/twocol/threecol/fourcol section layouts so only the Basic Layouts variants appear in the Layout Builder picker. The layouts pair well with Layout Builder Styles and Layout Builder Sections Config for further customization.
